snippet.title: Telerotation Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Telerotation is a brand-new puzzle game with a totally unique concept. rotate rooms, teleport, bend gravity, and alter room layouts to reach the exit of over 200 hand-made levels, it was made entirely by only 3 people.

This game is quite difficult and is very much geared for fans of puzzle games.

The game is almost done but we are still polishing some rough edges and updating some visuals.

Thanks for checking out our game!
